notes: Official tinySA wiki identifies tinySA as a small spectrum analyzer product line.
The page describes spectrum-analyzer and signal-generator capabilities and USB PC control.

resolution.name: tinySA 频谱分析仪
resolution.description: 用于射频信号观察与基础频谱分析的 tinySA 频谱分析仪，可通过 SCPI/USB 发送命令、执行原始频段扫描、抓取屏幕截图、自检，并调用多种射频测量功能。
resolution.description_en: A tinySA spectrum analyzer for RF signal observation and basic spectrum analysis. It can be controlled over SCPI/USB to send commands, perform raw frequency scans, capture screenshots, run self-tests, and invoke multiple RF measurement functions.

rationale: Web evidence supports the tinySA product identity and feature set. Manufacturer ownership remains uncertain at company-entity level, so it is left empty per workflow rule.
